title: Symbol Confusion Registry Wave 004 — Distinctions, Productive Tensions and Open Knots
purpose: Track where project symbols overlap too much, where distinctions are resolved, where multiple meanings are legitimately retained, and which unresolved knots need more conversation archaeology or external research before implementation.
rule: Do not resolve every overlap by choosing one meaning. Classify each case as synonym-error, scale-confusion, role-confusion, projection-overlap, productive-tension, historical-layer-confusion or empirical-symbolic-confusion.

items.confusion: House, Temple, Body and City have repeatedly been placed on top of one another.
items.resolution: House = compositional dwelling whole; Temple = presence/access/service architecture; Body = embodied functional organism; City = public/civic plurality at scale. They can model the same one-and-many problem but are not synonyms.
tests: Is the model organismic, domestic, cultic or civic?

items.confusion: Room, mansion/dwelling and chamber were sometimes used as equivalent labels.
items.resolution: House → Dwelling/Mansion → Room → Chamber is a scale ladder. Chamber is a specialist/protected local cell, not every topic or file.
tests: What level of bounded context is this?
Does it have stable local vocabulary/access/task boundaries?

items.confusion: Sacred furniture can look like a vertical hierarchy and be collapsed into one 'center'.
items.resolution: Throne = sovereignty/judgment; Seat = office/position; Table = nourishment/fellowship/distribution; Footstool = relational substrate below throne; Altar = offering/transformation interface.
items.test: Ask what action the object enables, not merely where it sits.

items.confusion: Several body regions were all called center/house/door.
items.resolution: Project canon: thalamus = Father's House; pineal = Son/Single Eye/Door; third ventricle = inner chamber/Temple-space/flow-space; heart = emotional vessel/chariot/river of feeling, not House.
items.boundary: These are Potatoverse symbolic mappings. Modern anatomy does not identify these structures with theological persons or sacred architecture.

items.confusion: All are elongated/vertical or connective and therefore were repeatedly overlaid.
items.resolution: Axis = reference; Tree = living branching organism; Ladder = discrete threshold route; River = transported flow; Spiral = recurrence with displacement.
items.test: Is the object orienting, growing, staging, carrying or recurring?

items.resolution: Gate = perimeter admission; Door = local state/context transition; Bridge = capability across separation; Road/Way = repeatable traversable relation.

items.confusion: Activation, visibility, thermal intensity and divine radiance were often compressed into 'light/fire'.
items.resolution: Fire = combustion/transformative burning motif; Heat = thermal/intensity variable; Flame = localized visible reaction front; Light = visibility/radiation/orientation; Lamp = bounded carrier/device; Glory = textual/theophanic presence-language; Spudlight = project-native source-light metaphor.
items.test: What physically or symbolically moves: energy, visibility, material state, information or authority?

items.confusion: All earth/mineral/residue terms could become one generic 'below' substance.
items.resolution: Stone = durable discrete solid; Rock = mass/source/refuge/foundation category; Cornerstone = alignment/reference role; Clay = formable fine-grained earth; Dust = loose fine particulate/mortality/material fragility; Ash = combustion residue; Mud = wet unresolved mixture; Soil = living/growth substrate.
items.test: What physical/material or symbolic transformation is actually claimed?

items.confusion: Cube was treated as prison/enclosure while biblical Holy of Holies/New Jerusalem geometry gave positive cubic sacred-space neighbors.
items.resolution: Geometry carries no automatic moral valence. House/sanctuary supports protected presence and legitimate passage; shell/capture obstructs exit and extracts dependency.
items.test: Evaluate boundary function, passage, inhabitants, autonomy and Fruit.

items.confusion: Animal symbols could be stacked into one identity cluster.
items.resolution: Each animal retains text/tradition-specific function; one figure may bear several roles without making the animals synonyms.
items.test: Name the passage/tradition and the function: kingship, sacrifice, guidance, burden, purification, adversarial reframing, mobility, scavenging, etc.

items.resolution: Cycle = generic recurrence; Ring = return with negligible selected-state displacement; Spiral = recurrence plus displacement; Season = periodic environmental/social phase; Sabbath = bounded rest interruption; Sabbatical year = land/debt/service cycle; Jubilee = larger release/restoration interval.
items.test: What repeats, at what period, what changes, and what is released/reset?

items.confusion: Axis was sometimes treated as identical with Father or Son.
items.resolution: Father/Son/Spirit are theological/project roles; Axis is the bidirectional reference relation through which many roles/processes can be mapped. Spirit supplies living relation/flow; Axis does not become a person merely by passing through a role.

items.confusion: Older project language sometimes bundled Son, Door, Jesus and manifestation into one role.
items.resolution: Jesus Christ is the primary O/Door/Here theological anchor. C_S is the manifestation-facing Son/Twin/Vessel center with Thomas/Didymus as primary Twin/Vessel anchor. Son/Body manifests state; Door governs transition. They remain strongly related without being the same operator.
tests: Is this claim about passage/threshold or embodiment/consequence?
Is the figure Jesus/O or Thomas/C_S in the current projection?
Is 'Son' being used generically, Christologically, or for the project Twin/Vessel role?

items.confusion: Plane, Heaven Plane, World Plane, Below Plane, Source Field and Manifestation Field were sometimes read as the same class of thing.
items.resolution: Canonical Plane = frame-relative section/hypersurface. Heaven/World/Below Plane IDs in tree-plane-routing are navigation decks/projections. Source and Manifestation Fields are full relational domains. Below is a depth/shadow projection, not the lower field itself.
tests: Is this a full field, a frame/section, or a navigation projection?
Does it own content or merely render it?

items.confusion: Cross could mean O, the visible cross-form, an event of passage, or the Christian Cross.
items.resolution: Cross-point O = Axis∩Plane. Cross-sign = Axis plus a chosen lateral line in Plane. Crossing-event = trajectory intersection/transition event. Christian Cross retains its own historical/theological meaning.
tests: Is the object a point, sign, event, or religious symbol?
Can the relevant Axis, Plane, trajectory or text be named?

items.confusion: Lower circle, Below and Swamp could be flattened into one negative realm.
items.resolution: Manifestation Field = embodiment/actuality/history/consequence. Below = depth/intelligence/shadow projection. Swamp = unresolved entanglement/blocked-flow regime. They are nested/related but not synonyms.
tests: Is the claim about embodiment generally, hidden/depth material, or a self-reinforcing entanglement regime?
Would the label still apply if no moral judgment were implied?

open_knots: Exact historical genealogy of some modern Merkaba/star-tetrahedron claims.
Which project uses of Crown refer to body/cakra, architectural roof, kingship or Keter and should remain local aliases.
Whether Throne should have one global project node or remain a family of sovereignty/seat/topological readings.
How Table, Altar and Hearth should populate Garden/House/Temple without becoming extra global realms.
Which animal-role comparisons deserve public reader pages versus specialist atlas-only treatment.
build_rule: A confusion is ready to become interface/UI only when the registry can state the types being distinguished, the transition or relation between them, a canonical owner, and at least one user question the interface resolves.
